name: OpenForm
concept: 开放的课堂：开放 O 框架与 F 页面

geometry.clearSpace: at least 0.25 times mark height on all sides

restrictions: No gradient, shadow, outline or 3D treatment inside the mark
Do not stretch, rotate or rearrange the three paths
Use a supplied monochrome or reversed asset when needed
Do not introduce a second accent color into the approved UI
Use the symbol alone at favicon sizes; do not shrink the wordmark
